risk_note: RV2 ledger + platform events (D10-188 ①; BR-FUND-18, 20). Registers asset_snapshot.timed_out and union_receivable.exposure_exceeded at their 02 §11 positions (SPEC_REF f3fea9b0) with the 02 §11 payloads (no personal data). createAssetSnapshotAlertQueue publishes them through EVENT_BUS in the snapshot's own transaction with a deterministic event id from (app_id, accounting_date, type), so a committed snapshot always has its alert queued and a replay does not queue it again; assembleAssetSnapshot makes the queue a required dependency (missing EVENT_BUS -> INVALID_INPUT), while createAssetSnapshot keeps the optional parameter because the frozen B2-04w kit calls it without one. Closes B2-04w money r4 S2: the confirm transaction locks and rereads the day's row, returns if already comparable, and reads the Clock only after the lock. Prerequisite test-changes B2-04wb (#1320) and B2-04wc (#1341) are merged.
